messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to flip the new caching+batching flag (ff/cache_batch_v2) behind a 5% prod canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need 1) quick sign-off from runtime/ops, 2) code-review ping resolved, 3) rollback checklist annotated. Will be gradual: 5% -> 25% -> 100% if metrics look fine.

kevin: +1 from infra — what's the preflight? which metrics should we watch first?

sarah: Main risks: increased p99 token latency due to larger batch formation, memory spikes on older instances, and KV cache invalidation storms. Watch p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU/GPU mem, and cache hit-rate by model.

diego: I added a small dashboard tile: /dashboards/ops/cache-batch-v2-canary that shows token_p95, model_kv_hitrate, batch_size, and oom_rate by host. Link: https://grafana.internal/d/cache-batch-v2-canary

maria: thx. For preflight I propose: run smoke tests in staging for 2h with simulated traffic, then prod canary for 2h at 5%. If no >5% regression at p95 and no OOMs, escalate to 25% for 1h. If any regression, rollback to ff off immediately.

kevin: How will we flip the flag? ops-bot can handle audience-based toggles?

ops-bot: You can use the FF CLI:
```
ff toggle set ff/cache_batch_v2 --state on --audience canary:5 --comment "canary rollout 2026-03-18 maria"
```
Will also create an audit event and page the oncall if we hit the OOM guardrail.

elaine: I requested a quick PR review (D3772) for the batching heuristic change — @kevin @sarah can you take a look? It's tiny but touches kernel selection.

kevin: I'll review now, aim to merge before 08:30 UTC.

sarah: Reviewing after a quick smoke run in staging. One question on the heuristic: we should cap batch size to 128 for Llama-2 models to avoid mem spikes. I'll leave a comment in PR.

maria: noted. Also adding an explicit rollback command in the playbook:
```
# immediate rollback
ff toggle set ff/cache_batch_v2 --state off --comment "rollback - canary abnormal metrics"
# fallback: route to legacy variant
route update --model default:legacy_batch --policy force
```

maria: Can we agree on alert thresholds? propose: token_p95 > baseline*1.12 for 5 consecutive mins OR host_oom_count > 0 triggers paging.

diego: +1 to thresholds. I'll wire alerts: alert_if(token_p95_replace > baseline*1.12, for=5m) and on host_oom_count > 0 immediate.

kevin: Ops knobs: enable per-host circuit breaker at 10% error rate + auto-pin to smaller batch size. Do we have that implemented?

sarah: yes we shipped the circuit breaker in last sprint — config key: runtime.circuit.breaker.batch_error_pct with default 10. We'll set it to 8 for canary.

maria: Great. Final plan checklist:
- [ ] PR D3772 merged
- [ ] Staging 2h smoke pass (maria/sarah)
- [ ] Ops dashboard + alerts (diego)
- [ ] Canary flip 5% 09:00 UTC using ops-bot (maria)
- [ ] Monitor for 2h, then 25% if green
- [ ] Rollback if alerts fire (immediate)

elaine: Added a short note in the PR about rolling forward vs rollback criteria.

oncall-bot: Reminder: On-call rotation (kevin) will be paged for critical alerts during the canary window 09:00-11:00 UTC.

maria: pinging product for visibility — @product-leticia we're running this canary tomorrow, no feature changes to API surface, purely infra perf.

kevin: merged D3772. staging smoke started 07:10 UTC, running load script:
```
./scripts/load_test --profile canary-sim --duration 2h --concurrency 120
```

kevin: staging looks stable after 1h, p95 within 2% of baseline, no OOMs.

maria: proceeding to schedule 09:00 UTC canary. I'll run the toggle and post status updates here.

maria: 09:00 UTC - toggled to 5% canary via ops-bot.

ops-bot: Audit: ff/cache_batch_v2 set to on for canary:5 by maria at 1767506400.

diego: dashboards show batch_size median=24, token_p95 +3% so far, kv_hitrate stable. No host_ooms.

kevin: lowering circuit breaker from 10 -> 8 for the canary window.

sarah: noticed one host with slightly elevated GC, watching.

maria: 09:45 UTC - p95 drift now 11% on one model shard, but overall below threshold. Keeping canary.

maria: 10:15 UTC - p95 breach >12% for 6m on model-x. Triggering rollback.

ops-bot: Paging oncall (kevin) — alert token_p95 > baseline*1.12 for 6m.

oncall-bot: Kevin acknowledged the page at 1767507300.

kevin: Executing rollback now.

kevin: Rolling ff off:
```
ff toggle set ff/cache_batch_v2 --state off --comment "rollback - p95 breach on model-x"
```

ops-bot: Audit: ff/cache_batch_v2 set to off by kevin at 1767507375.

maria: Re-routing to legacy variant and monitoring.

maria: Postmortem note: root cause looks like an interaction between new batching heuristic and model-x's dynamic prompt lengths producing larger-than-expected batches. We'll revert heuristic tweak in next PR and try a smaller canary window with model-specific caps.

elaine: I'll open D3783 to revert and add model-specific limits. Assigning to @sarah for follow-up testing.

kevin: Thanks everyone — clean rollback, alerts worked. Let's sync tomorrow in eng-platform stand to schedule the reattempt after fixes. :thumbsup:

sarah: +1 — adding test in CI to simulate variable prompt lengths for model-x.

maria: closing the rollout ticket for now and capturing actions. Good catch team.
